THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
WINTER
040
STUDY 023
Blue Jacket in Profile
Rights check
Source: 24605.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long black hair and full
bangs looks over her shoulder with a faint, closed-lip
smile. She wears a blue track jacket with white stripes
along the sleeves. Snowy mountains fill the
background, with soft, even sunlight. Her profile is softly
lit, and the palette is cobalt blue, white, and black. Quiet
and poised, in the style of a minimal winter lookbook.
Quiet, poised, soft
WORKING NOTES
- The faint smile and profile angle set the tone.
- Describe the lighting as 'soft, even sunlight' to avoid
harsh shadows.
Try this: Specify soft, even sunlight.
